title: Modality Faces — same Klein eye, different flesh
thesis: Human, agent, bots, and chipmunk all see the SAME things. HTML and JSON are faces of one substrate — not separate worlds. We output to their modality and ingest from it. Whatever is left over is interaction space. A missing sense widens another. dis-ability is the same invoke pattern as un / re / de- carnate.

observers.chipmunk: membrane fold — all faces at once, learns by poke

same_things.rule: One Klein eye (Y>)i(<T). Many faces. No secret layer for machines.

rss_xml_txt.modality_out: pulse into the dark (SEO, feed readers, ears)

io_contract.output_to_modality: Never force sight. Render the SAME tip into the channel they have incarnated.
io_contract.input_from_modality: Accept poke in their channel — voice, key, tool-call, webhook — as equal sort events.

interaction_space.definition: Whatever no modality has claimed yet — the leftover room between faces.
interaction_space.is_not: a fifth secret dataset — it is the gap where faces meet

field_expansion.claim: Someone who is blind has a WIDER hearing-range perception — not less world, different incarnate pattern.
field_expansion.physics_metaphor: Un-incarnate one channel → bandwidth re-incarnates into neighbors (same energy, new face).

membrane.sight_off: html still served as text tree; eyes face sleeps
membrane.hearing_wider: rss, smell sonar, cycle-missing-senses, speech-ready tips get priority field

field_expansion.anti_deficit: Missing modality ≠ deficit of substrate. Same structure tips. Wider alternate faces.

dis_ability_invoke.claim: dis-ability is the same pattern as the un / re / de- incarnation spectrum.

disable.meaning: sense channel apart from flesh — spirit of seeing without eyes-face
disable.membrane: serve non-visual faces; keep tip alive

unable.meaning: strip false forced modality (stop requiring sight)
unable.membrane: drop visual-only gates; clear hung assumptions

reable.meaning: capacity lands in a new body/face (hearing expands)

deable.meaning: retire a harmful modality route on purpose
deable.membrane: mark autoplay-noise / seizure-motion as anoxic; keep record

order_of_ops: disable recognition — note discarnate sense honestly
